## 中文

**推荐下载 GGScanner（当前文件名 `GOODCapture.exe`）**，一个程序即可使用抓包、OCR 扫描与管理功能，并可在窗口顶部切换《原神》和《崩坏：星穹铁道》。

| 下载文件 | 功能与区别 |
| --- | --- |
| **GGScanner：`GOODCapture.exe`（推荐）** | 包含抓包、OCR 扫描、导出与管理功能。抓包之外也能使用 OCR，功能更完整。 |
| GGScannerOCR：`GOODScanner.exe` | 仅包含 OCR 扫描、导出与管理功能，不包含抓包代码及依赖。适合明确不需要抓包的用户。 |

抓包由用户主动启动。两款游戏共用以上两个程序，无需另行下载星穹铁道专用程序。

两个版本都是社区工具，并非 HoYoverse 官方产品。OCR 版表示不包含抓包功能，不代表获得官方许可，也不代表已证实账号处罚风险更低。请了解游戏的[服务条款](https://genshin.hoyoverse.com/en-us/company/terms)。

GOODScanner 现更名为 GGScanner，下载文件名暂时保留不变，之后再改为 `GGScanner.exe` 和 `GGScannerOCR.exe`。旧文件名会继续保留以兼容自动更新。手动下载请选择上表中的两个文件；带构建编号的文件及 `update.json` 供自动更新使用。已安装的程序更新后可能继续保留原文件名。

## English

**Download GGScanner (currently named `GOODCapture.exe`) for the recommended edition.** It combines packet capture, OCR scanning, and management in one application, with a game switcher for Genshin Impact and Honkai: Star Rail.

| Download | Features and differences |
| --- | --- |
| **GGScanner: `GOODCapture.exe` (recommended)** | Includes packet capture, OCR scanning, export, and management. OCR remains available alongside capture, giving you more ways to export data. |
| GGScannerOCR: `GOODScanner.exe` | Includes OCR scanning, export, and management, with capture code and dependencies excluded. Choose this if you specifically prefer an edition without packet capture. |

Capture starts when you choose to start it. Both executables support both games; there is no separate Star Rail application to download.

Both editions are unofficial community tools. OCR-only describes the included features, not official approval or a demonstrated lower risk of account penalties. Review the game's [terms of service](https://genshin.hoyoverse.com/en-us/company/terms).

GOODScanner is now called GGScanner. Download filenames remain unchanged for now; they will become `GGScanner.exe` and `GGScannerOCR.exe` later. The old filenames will remain available for auto-update compatibility. For a manual download, choose one of the two files in the table. Files with a build number and `update.json` are used for auto-updates. An existing installation may retain its original filename after updating.
